facts: ESLint applies typescript-eslint recommendedTypeChecked, consistent-type-imports (use `import type` for types) and no-floating-promises to src/**/*.ts and tests/**/*.ts; require-await is active, so an async function must await something.
tsconfig is strict with noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes and verbatimModuleSyntax; relative imports end in .js (for example ../types/workspaces.js).

Tests use vitest ^3.2.4 (describe/it/expect from "vitest"). Integration tests use createTestDatabase/resetTestDatabase/seedApiKey from tests/helpers/postgres.ts, which start pgvector/pgvector:pg17 with testcontainers and run all migrations.
The protected feature test tests/integration/workspace-report.feature.test.ts and specs/constitution.md plus specs/constitution.approval.json must not be edited.

Lint includes no-unsafe-assignment, no-unsafe-member-access, no-unsafe-return and no-unsafe-call: an untyped pg query result has rows of type any and fails them. Always pass a row type, in code and in tests: `const result = await pool.query<{ id: string; count: number }>(sql, params);` then `result.rows[0]?.id`. Type caught errors and JSON values as unknown and narrow them.

The slice check runs `node changes/004-report-core/slice-check.mjs <files>`: Vitest on the slice test and ESLint with --max-warnings=0 on every listed .ts file. Both must pass with zero lint problems.
Types AgentSessionRow, AgentKind, SessionEvent, SessionStatus are in src/types/workspaces.ts (report-s1). Tests insert machines and workspaces rows with plain SQL.
pg ^8.16.3: client.query<Row>(sql, params) returns { rows, rowCount }; use `import type { PoolClient } from "pg"`.
